dialogue_segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave)
dialogue_segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
dialogue_segments.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.

dialogue_segments.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

dialogue_segments.text: Careful men who help me also get remembered.
